name: Jeffrey A. Weissman
tagline: Top rated Family Law attorney in Boca Raton, Florida
about: Jeffrey A. Weissman is a Principal/Shareholder of the law firm of Gladstone, Weissman, Hirschberg & Schneider, P.A. He is a graduate of the University of Pennsylvania Law School (J.D., 1994). Mr. Weissman is Board Certified in Marital and Family Law and is AV Preeminent Rated by Martindale- Hubbell. He is a Fellow in the International Academy of Matrimonial Lawyers. He is also a Supreme Court Certified Family Law Mediator and is formally trained in Collaborative Law. Mr. Weissman limits his practice to complex matrimonial and family law cases. His clientele is comprised of many successful entrepreneurs, business owners and executives, doctors, lawyers, television personalities, and professional athletes. Mr. Weissman was recently named the “2026 Family Law Lawyer of the Year” by Best Lawyers in America. He similarly received this recognition in 2024, 2021, 2018, 2016, and 2014.
